newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Businessmen from Gulf Arab states and the European Union callfor changes to existing legislation governing foreign investment in Gulf countries.
- Saudi to purchase a third frigate from France and equip it with modern air defence devices.
- Riyadh governor lays the foundation stone for the 523 million riyal King Abdulaziz cultural centre.
- New evidence presented in trial of two British nurses accused of murdering their Australian colleague in Khobar.
- Eastern Province governor launches a 30 million riyal corniche project.
- Finance ministers of Gulf Arab states to discuss tariffs in Qatar on Saturday.
- Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah receives Qatari foreign minister in Jeddah.
- Riyadh governor Prince Salman inaugurates GCC-EU meeting in Riyadh.
- Saudi finance minister says the kingdom is reviewing Saudi stock market and is studying the possibility of opening the market for foreign investors.
